objective: Make the stable public Ron System Core URL impossible to lose during continuation recovery by pinning the verified endpoint directly in BOOTSTRAP.md and adding an explicit endpoint-reuse rule, while preserving all existing routing, ownership, authority and live-state semantics.

roles_before.artifact: BOOTSTRAP.md is the mandatory first recovery surface for Ron System continuation.
The verified public System Core endpoint already exists in projects/lifeup-system.md but can be overlooked during recovery.
projects/lifeup-system.md remains the current System project owner; Neon/PostgreSQL remains mutable derived-state owner.
Native ChatGPT memory is only a bootstrap pointer and must not own mutable/current System state.
Git history and exact base SHA preserve the pre-hardening bootstrap text.

role_dispositions.destination: Keep all existing runtime-routing rules intact and add only one endpoint-reuse instruction.

Promote the already-verified endpoint locator into BOOTSTRAP.md Supporting files so it is visible on the mandatory first read, while projects/lifeup-system.md continues to hold the detailed runtime evidence.
No authority, write gate, owner, player state or live-source contract changes.
Memory remains non-authoritative; future chats recover the endpoint from canonical bootstrap/current owners rather than relying on memory.
Base SHA a8df6876ddf34403c231b2c58d45d004e7480709 and Git history preserve exact prior bootstrap text.

capability_probes.assertion: A fresh BOOTSTRAP.md read exposes the exact public System Core URL https://p01--system-core--yh2fvbyd9vfg.code.run/ without needing memory or historical search.
All canonical routing steps, current-owner selection, live-owner requirements and architecture/change rules remain unchanged.
The endpoint pin must not turn ChatGPT memory into a mutable/current-state owner or bypass projects/lifeup-system.md and live verification when the endpoint is later superseded.
Finance, health, learning, ecommerce, mobility and other domain routing remain byte-for-byte semantically unchanged.
Exact base SHA restores the prior bootstrap locator text and routing behavior.

tests.command: read BOOTSTRAP.md from candidate and verify exact canonical System Core locator + endpoint-reuse rule
tests.expected: Exact verified URL appears in the mandatory first-read bootstrap and the rule says not to rediscover a different URL from memory unless a verified runtime change supersedes it.
Architecture manifest and same-push-range gate pass.
All continuity/routing regression checks pass with no owner or routing loss.
System/LifeUp static contract remains green; no runtime/player-state mutation occurs.
